title: Launch command, Mobile to Unity (protocol 1)
description: JSON argument of UnitySendMessage("Fire3DBridge", "Launch", json). Mobile sends it only after BE start succeeded (POST /api/training/sessions/{id}/start or POST /api/playtests/{id}/start) and every package file passed its SHA-256 check. It carries no launch grant, continuation or user token: Unity never verifies or stores credentials.

sessionId.description: Learner session id or playtest id from BE.

mode.description: Training mode of the session; must be in the scenario modePolicy.allowedModes (Unity answers MODE_NOT_ALLOWED otherwise).

runtimeVersion.description: Runtime version pinned by the session (TrainingSessionView.runtimeVersion).

manifestPath.description: Absolute local path of the verified fet3d.package/1 manifest.json; the other files sit next to it at their manifest path.

resumeFromSequence.description: 0 for a new play; when resuming, BE acknowledgedSequence. Unity numbers events from resumeFromSequence + 1.
